description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'LayoutTemplate' used as a base for layout templates in the OpenMRS system, specifically for AddressTemplate and NameTemplate layouts. It contains fields and methods related to managing layout structure, tokens, and elements, including token replacement, line parsing, and format management.

classes.name: LayoutTemplate
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for layout templates used in address and name layouts within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: replaceTokens
methods.description: Replaces tokens in a given line with a predefined layout token string.

methods.name: convertToTokens
methods.description: Converts a line into a list of tokens and non-tokens, identifying their type and associated metadata.

methods.name: getLines
methods.description: Returns a list of tokenized lines based on the lineByLineFormat property.

methods.name: getMaxTokens
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of tokens on any line, computing if not already set.

methods.name: nonUniqueStringsGoLast
methods.description: Reorders a list of strings so that non-unique strings are placed at the end of the list.
